name: UAE Information Assurance Regulation (control families)
publisher: UAE Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (summarised by AEGIS)
licenseNote: The UAE Information Assurance Regulation is issued for UAE government entities and critical sectors. AEGIS references its management and technical control family identifiers only; every title and summary is original AEGIS wording and is not the text of the regulation. Entities must work from the regulation as issued. Mapping an AEGIS record to a family here is not a compliance assessment.
description: The management (M1 to M6) and technical (T1 to T9) control families of the UAE Information Assurance Regulation, with the AI-agent controls AEGIS can evidence against each.

controls.title: Strategy and planning
controls.summary: The entity sets an information assurance strategy, approves policies and assigns roles, including ownership of AI systems that act on its behalf.

controls.title: Information security risk management
controls.summary: Risks to information and systems, including risks from AI agents and automation, are identified, assessed, treated and accepted by named risk owners.

controls.title: Awareness and training
controls.summary: Staff understand their security responsibilities, including how to review and approve actions requested by AI agents.

controls.title: Human resources security
controls.summary: Security responsibilities are set before, during and after employment, and access held by people and the agents they own is removed when roles change.

controls.title: Compliance
controls.summary: Legal, regulatory and contractual obligations are identified, and evidence shows that controls operate as intended.

controls.title: Performance evaluation and improvement
controls.summary: The effectiveness of controls is monitored, measured and reviewed, and weaknesses are tracked to remediation.

controls.title: Asset management
controls.summary: Information assets and the systems that process them, including AI agents, their tools and their connections, are inventoried, classified and owned.

controls.title: Physical and environmental security
controls.summary: Facilities and equipment that hold information are protected against unauthorised access and environmental hazards.

controls.title: Operations management
controls.summary: Operating procedures, change control, logging, monitoring and protection against malicious code keep systems secure and their activity traceable, including every action an AI agent takes.

controls.title: Communications
controls.summary: Networks and information in transit are protected, and transfers of information to external parties are controlled and recorded.

controls.title: Access control
controls.summary: Access by people and automated agents is granted on need, strongly authenticated, limited to approved actions, reviewed and revoked promptly.

controls.title: Third party security
controls.summary: Suppliers, cloud services and AI model providers are assessed, bound by security requirements and monitored.

controls.title: Information systems acquisition, development and maintenance
controls.summary: Security requirements are built into systems that are bought or developed, changes are tested, and software components are checked for known weaknesses.

controls.title: Information security incident management
controls.summary: Security events, including attacks aimed at AI agents, are detected, reported, contained and learned from, with records kept.

controls.title: Information systems continuity management
controls.summary: Critical services continue through disruption, with tested backup and recovery, and AI agents can be paused without losing control of outstanding actions.
